text: Re-read at 0.55.5. The two comments here still describe the code beside them exactly: the module-path/attribute-path walk is unchanged, and the namespace-package trap paragraph still guards the same continue. The function gained one call - _evict_if_foreign, before each import attempt - and that step carries its own docstring explaining why sys.modules must not be allowed to hand this repo another repo's module. Nothing the existing comments assert has moved.
